newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker weak, enquiries thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker weak, enquiries thin.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices edged down slightly on Thursday in quiet trading as some Chinese players were still out of the market for the Lunar New Year holidays, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $101-$105 and 380-cst was at $93-97 per tonne, compared with $103-$107 and $96-$101 respectively on Wednesday.
"We probably have to wait until next week when all traders return to their desk from holiday," said one trader.
MDO and gas oil were quoted largely unchanged at $188-$192 and $198-202 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
